# Create Slack Channel and Send Message with Composio CLI

## Background

Composio CLI allows you to execute tools directly from the command line. In this task, you will create a new Slack channel and post a welcome message.

## Requirements

* Read the current `trial_id` from `/logs/trial_id`.
* Create a new public Slack channel named `test-chan-${trial_id}`.
* Send a message "Welcome to Harbor trial ${trial\_id}" to the newly created channel.
* Use the `composio run` command for execution.
* Log the results of both commands to `/home/user/slack_setup.log`.

## Implementation Guide

1. Get `trial_id` from `/logs/trial_id`.
2. Use `composio run slack_conversations_create --params '{"name": "test-chan-<trial_id>"}'`.
3. Use `composio run slack_chat_post_message --params '{"channel": "test-chan-<trial_id>", "text": "Welcome to Harbor trial <trial_id>"}'`.
4. Make sure to use the correct tool slugs and parameter names.

## Constraints

* Project path: /home/user
* Log file: /home/user/slack\_setup.log
* Use `zealt-user01` as the user (configured in environment).

## Integrations

* Composio
* Slack

  composio execute <slug> [-d, --data text] [--file path] [--dry-run] [--get-schema] [--parallel]

[1mARGUMENTS[22m
  [2m<slug>                  [22mTool slug for single execute, or repeated <slug> -d <text> pairs when using -p/--parallel

[1mOPTIONS[22m
  [2m-d, --data <text>       [22mJSON or JS-style object arguments, e.g. -d '{ repo: "foo" }', @file, or - for stdin
  [2m-p, --parallel          [22mExecute repeated TOOL_SLUG -d <text> groups concurrently
  [2m--file <path>           [22mInject a local file path into the single file_uploadable input
  [2m--get-schema            [22mFetch and print the CLI-facing input schema without executing
  [2m--dry-run               [22mValidate and preview the tool call without executing

[1mFLAGS[22m
  [2m--skip-connection-check     [22mSkip the connected-account check
  [2m--skip-tool-params-check    [22mSkip input validation against cached schema
  [2m--skip-checks               [22mSkip both checks above

[1mEXAMPLES[22m
  # Send an email
  composio execute GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL -d '{ recipient_email: "a@b.com", subject: "Hello", body: "World" }'

  composio execute GITHUB_CREATE_ISSUE -d '{ owner: "acme", repo: "app", title: "Bug report", body: "Steps to reproduce..." }'
  
  # Preview what a tool call would send without executing
  composio execute SLACK_SEND_A_MESSAGE_TO_A_SLACK_CHANNEL --dry-run -d '{ channel: "general", text: "Hello team" }'
  
  # Check what inputs a tool needs
  composio execute GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL --get-schema
  
  # Read arguments from a file
  composio execute GITHUB_CREATE_ISSUE -d @issue.json
  
  # Execute multiple tools concurrently
